subject: Recap + one quick ask: run a 15-minute mini-pilot?

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + one quick ask: run a 15-minute mini-pilot?

Hi Elena / Michael — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of what we covered and one small ask so we can make progress without a heavy commitment:

Call recap (3 bullets):
- Goal: validate retrieval + prompt templates on a sample of your support KB and evaluate latency/cost at your target concurrency.
- Fit signals: GreenArc cares about short tail latency (<200ms median), deterministic output for reranking, and SSO/KMS for data control.
- Constraints you mentioned: small initial budget for POC, legal wants a simple SOW for scope.

One ask: Would you be open to a 15-minute mini-pilot where we run 10 sample queries against a sanitized slice of your KB (no production data) and share the results + cost estimates? We’ll handle the dataset ingestion and remove any identifiers — the outcome is a short report and a simple SOW stub.

If yes, we can do it as early as next week. Two lightweight options:
- Option A: Rishi runs the test remotely (hosted) using a redacted dataset you drop in a secure folder.
- Option B: Demo in your tenant (private) — takes ~1 extra day for network config.

Can you reply with a quick yes/no on the mini-pilot? If yes, I’ll send the two-minute checklist and a calendar slot. If no, a sentence on the blocker is totally fine — helps us prioritize.

Thanks —
Kim

--

Hi Elena / Michael — following up on my note below. I know budgets move slowly — two quick asks to unblock either direction:

1) Quick yes/no on the 15-minute mini-pilot (we'll handle the scrub). A one-word reply helps us prioritize.
2) If "no" or "not yet," are you able to share the primary blocker (timing, scope, security)?

Why it’s low friction:
- We only need a static CSV of 200 sample lines (attached sample-query-list.csv) — no access to production systems.
- We’ll deliver a 1-page findings doc and a short cost sheet.
- Attachment: redwood-minipilot-sow.pdf (one-page, scope + data handling).

If easier, here are two 15-minute slots I can send: Thu 4/23 10:30am PT or Fri 4/24 9:00am PT. If neither works, tell me a single preferred day.

Thanks for being direct — that helps us move quickly.

Best,
Kim
